definitions.explanation: Fat stored in the body. Commonly discussed in health, fitness, and medical contexts, especially in relation to body fat percentage.

examples.japanese: {体脂肪|たいしぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧。
{体脂肪|たいしぼう}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{測|はか}っている→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: I measure my body fat percentage every month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧たら、{体脂肪|たいしぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{下|さ}がって→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After continuing to exercise, my body fat dropped significantly and my health checkup results improved too.

notes:
{体脂肪|たいしぼう} combines ⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (body) + ⟦{脂肪|しぼう}→脂肪：03199_shibou⟧ (fat). Commonly discussed in health, fitness, and medical contexts.
